messages:
alex: Heads up — after merge r3456 we're seeing a compile surge on prod GPU pool. Compile rate x4, p99 token latency up ~3x, KV cache miss rate +18%. Rollout looks like a blocker.
maria: which merge? any selector/autopick changes in it?
alex: it was feat/autopick-fallback (PR 942). quick logs:
```
[autopick] model=redwood-v2 seq=32 selected=debug_fma score=0.81 reason=heuristic_weighted
[autopick] model=redwood-v2 seq=64 selected=debug_fma score=0.79 reason=heuristic_weighted
compile-submit: /srv/compile/bin/compile --variant debug_fma --model redwood-v2
kv-cache: evict model=redwood-v2 key=prefix-... cause=memory_pressure
```
sam: debug_fma? that's a debug-optimized binary, not intended for prod. PR 942 changed the scoring to prefer lower compile time, right? seems the heuristic now biases debug variants.
maria: yep that matches local repro. I reverted the heuristic change locally and compile submissions dropped ~70%.
jen: @deploy-bot what's the rollout state?
deploy-bot: rollout feat/autopick-fallback v2 at 60% (canary paused) — recent spikes triggered alert: compile-rate-high.
alex: can we stop the rollout and roll back the PR? we need a hotfix.
dk: pushing a revert PR #948 to restore previous scoring weights. git cmd: `git revert --no-commit 7f4c2e1 && git commit -m "revert: revert heuristic weight change (hotfix)"`
maria: also we should invalidate any debug_fma artifacts and prevent autopick from choosing debug variants while rollback propagates. quick fix: add a runtime flag `--prefer-stable-kernels` default true for prod.
sam: agree. we should also flush KV entries that reference debug kernels so they don't cause cache thrash. command to abort outstanding compiles and drain queue: `scripts/compile/abort_outstanding.sh --pool=prod-gpu --tag=autopick-debug`
alex: ran the abort script — aborted 112 compile jobs, compile queue length dropped from 138 -> 9.
jen: good. can we also run a short profiling sweep to confirm KV hit rate recovers?
maria: running profiler job now on canary nodes, will post numbers in ~3m. initial expectation: hit rate back to baseline in 1-2 mins after eviction stabilizes.
dk: reverted PR #942 merged to hotfix branch, CI perf tests queued. I'll request expedited CI.
alex: thanks everyone. action items: 1) roll back merge (dk), 2) add runtime flag to block debug variants (maria), 3) flush debug artifacts (sam), 4) run profiling and validate KV hit + latency (alex/maria). keep this thread updated. :eyes:
maria: quick note for postmortem — need to add a unit test that prevents selecting non-stable kernel variants when env=prod.
sam: also add telemetry metric for "autopick_variant_type" so we can alert if debug-like variants exceed 0.
alex: logging captured, creating PM with timeline and linking PRs. will update when rollback is live.
